summary: End-to-end testing of the live GitHub repository audit feature (A21 Stack Profiler). Backend 11/11 pytest cases pass (validation 400s, 502 on non-existent repo, full ingest shape for project/profile/finding_summary/reports/gates, and persistence in projects/findings/ledger). Frontend /repo-audit flow passes: URL prefilled, Run Live Audit → progress → repo-audit-result renders stack profile (JS/TS/JSON/YAML/Shell/Python + Express/FastAPI/PostgreSQL/React, 100 files/~12,855 LOC), severity chips (low:66, high:7), both report cards (author narrative 2.8KB, team-lead 877B) with ledger hashes, all 10 gate cards (G1/G2 Ready, G4/G8 At Risk, others Not Assessed/Not Started), open-findings-btn/open-gates-btn navigate correctly. Project switcher updates to myauction-node automatically, success toast appears. Regression (/harness, /model-settings, /mlops, /ledger) loads with zero console errors. No functional defects found.
critical_code_review_comments: repo_ingest._clone_and_scan correctly uses asyncio.to_thread via caller, shallow clone --depth 1, 120s subprocess timeout, GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT=0 to avoid credential prompts, and shutil.rmtree in finally for cleanup — good.
URL validation regex ^https://github.com/<org>/<repo>/?$ rejects gitlab and malformed URLs (returns 400). Clone failure maps to RuntimeError -> 502 (good semantic separation).
Each ingest creates a NEW project (by design); over many runs this will accumulate duplicates — consider adding an idempotency/upsert path or a 'already-audited' guard in the future.
framework detection is substring-based ('fastapi' in text.lower() etc.) — false positive risk if a comment mentions a framework. Acceptable for prototype.
MAX_FILES=4000 / MAX_BYTES=350KB per file are reasonable guard rails; break only exits inner loop (not outer os.walk) — not critical for small repos but worth noting.
level2_status is manually set on logging/static findings via engine._apply_a05_rescan or direct assignment ensuring no NOT_ASSESSED leaks through — matches assertion.
seed_data_creation: Each test run creates a new 'myauction-node' project via live ingest (expected, per main-agent note). Validation tests only trigger clone for the nonexistent-repo case (fails fast).
context_for_next_testing_agent: New backend pytest file /app/backend/tests/test_repo_audit.py has 11 tests. Must run with -n 0 (serial) since the slow ingest (~30-60s) is shared via module-scoped fixture; also must export REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL from frontend/.env before invoking pytest. The nonexistent-repo test returns 502 as HTML from the ingress (not JSON) — the test checks status code only. The live myauction-node audit returns 73 findings (66 Static Code low, 7 India PII high), profile languages dict + frameworks ['Express','FastAPI','PostgreSQL','React'], 100 files/~12,855 LOC, both author+team_lead reports have narratives >20 chars with ledger_hash, 10 gates with G4/G8 At Risk. Frontend data-testids on /repo-audit all present and wired: repo-audit-page, repo-url-input (prefilled), run-repo-audit-btn, repo-audit-result, sev-low, sev-high, open-findings-btn, open-gates-btn, report-author, report-team_lead, gate-G1..gate-G10.
